about: A Navi chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3; the Darkloids' first batch, docs/multirom/bn4-chips.md, Past 511): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan with a folder of one ShadeMan S and 29 Cannon A in both games, the ShadeMan dealt first (a Mega chip: a folder of them alone never deals), BN5's chip 260 by BN5's own code and the registry's 505 by the same code moved (BN5's Navi routine 0x01 as BN6's 0x1E: its Navi's battle sprite the Navis' own, list 2's 0x27, LZ77 in BN5 and queued there, whole in BN6; his attack moved with it), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
